Request A Quote Windshield Auto Glass Replacement Your windshield is the most important piece of glass in your vehicle. You may think that when you get pulled over and ticketed for a cracked windshield that you are being unfairly targeted for a non-serious violation, but a cracked windshield is more dangerous than you think. Your windshield does more than shield you from the wind — it provides needed structural support to your vehicle. If you are in an accident in which your vehicle rolls over, your windshield helps prevent your roof from caving in and crushing you. If your windshield is cracked — or if it’s installed incorrectly — it has a much greater chance of collapsing. If you notice a chip or a small crack in your windshield, call Sanders Glass auto glass company right away. When caught early, windshield damage can sometimes be repaired.
